cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The evaluation recorder passed the provider response on with its content-encoding header after reading the decoded body, so the client decoded it a second time, failed, and the adapter resent requests that had succeeded (three identical requests per step in the pilot).
impact: The first pilot records were invalid and discarded; fixed before the baseline started, verified with 16 distinct request hashes in 16 calls.
lesson: An evaluation instrument is code under test: verify it on a pilot (request counts, hashes) before trusting a round.

cause: The v1.9.0 baseline takes hours and model runs import product code lazily, so implementation edits in the version worktree could leak into baseline tasks.
impact: The baseline runs from a detached checkout of tag v1.9.0 (.worktrees/eval-v190-baseline) with the harness copied in; four tasks already finished in the version worktree before any product change are kept; results go to the version worktree's local/agent-eval.
lesson: Run a long baseline from a pinned checkout so development can continue without contaminating it.

cause: The workflow adapter for iv.gmm and iv.weak_instruments passes the bound exog columns without an intercept, unlike the diagnostics and GLM-extension adapters; the pack oracle tests supply an explicit constant, so the consumer path was never compared with an oracle.
impact: Shipped since the IV-GMM pack was wired into workflows: Agent-run GMM estimates and weak-instrument partial F are wrong on data without a constant column (partial F 6223.5 instead of 170.6 in the baseline task); one baseline task concluded instruments were strong when the true first-stage F is about 4.
lesson: Oracle-test the path the consumer calls, not only the kernel; a kernel test with hand-built design matrices cannot see what the adapter leaves out.
